goal: Generate a main visual for an anime featuring a single protagonist, styled like a movie poster, in 3:4 portrait orientation, with strong narrative and material contrasts.

ip.title: Bronze bell and steam city
ip.tagline: She repairs time and also mends people's hearts.

items: A girl mechanic with double braids, goggles pushed up on her forehead, leather apron full of brass tools, right hand holding a wrench, left hand holding a steam lamp emitting warm orange light, standing in silhouette against a large tilted gear
characters.composition_relationship: Slight low-angle view, the main character occupies about 65% of the height of the image, with gears and pipes in the background forming radiating lines converging towards the back of their head

world.scene: The elevated London-style footbridge under the night sky, iron frame, copper pipes, depressurizing white mist, distant clock tower glowing through half-hidden fog
world.lighting: Main light backlit with warm orange lamp, auxiliary light with cool blue moonlight outlining from the right, metallic surface highlights capping distribution
world.atmosphere: Mysterious, slightly dangerous, but the protagonist's gaze is steady.

style.art_style: Modern anime + cyber and steampunk details + semi-realistic leather and metal
style.color_palette: Deep cobalt blue, brass gold, coal black, lantern warm orange, small amount of steam white

title_block.position: 12% area at the top of the screen, small subtitle does not compete with the main title

must_keep: Single character's face is clear, props narrative is explicit
Warm-cool contrast serves the focus (lantern and eyes)
Title does not obscure the face or block the main lines of the wrench's dynamic posture.
avoid: 背景齿轮细节密度超过人物面部
The same image contains more than two conflicting era symbols (such as prohibiting modern LED large screens)
